description: This file defines an interface 'MaterialsProviderInterfaceV2' within the AWS SDK for PHP, specifying methods for cryptographic operations related to key management and encryption.

classes.name: MaterialsProviderInterfaceV2
classes.description: Interface for cryptographic materials provider supporting key size validation, key decryption, CEK generation, and IV generation.

methods.name: isSupportedKeySize
methods.description: Checks if a specified key size in bits is supported by AES.

methods.name: getWrapAlgorithmName
methods.description: Returns the name of the wrapping algorithm used by the provider.

methods.name: decryptCek
methods.description: Decrypts an encrypted content encryption key (CEK) using provider-specific methods.

methods.name: generateCek
methods.description: Generates a new content encryption key (CEK) along with associated context and options.

methods.name: generateIv
methods.description: Generates an initialization vector using a specified OpenSSL cipher name.
